progress.command:
git fetch -q origin; git log --oneline -3 origin/main; git status --short; for d in /home/runner/work/_temp/pi-action-extensions-*/node_modules/pit; do grep -m1 '"version"' $d/package.json; done; gh issue view 365 -R cv/pit --json state --jq .state; gh pr list --search "55 in:body" --state open --json number,title; python3 -c "
import zlib,struct
w,h=3000,3000
raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+bytes([(x*255//w) for x in range(w)])*1 for y in range(h))
def c(t,d): return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
open('/tmp/big.png','wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+c(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,0,0,0,0))+c(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw))+c(b'IEND',b''))
"; file /tmp/big.png
